intent.raw_query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June 2026

experiences.name: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day
experiences.description: Spend a full day at the iconic Magic Kingdom, home to Cinderella Castle, Space Mountain, and the Festival of Fantasy parade. Arrive at rope drop (park opening) to maximize ride time and avoid peak crowds. With a late flight arrival on Day 1, plan this for Day 2 onward. Stay on-site at a Disney Resort hotel such as Disney's Contemporary Resort or Disney's Polynesian Village Resort to use Early Theme Park Entry and minimize travel time to the park gates.
experiences.location: Magic Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour
experiences.description: Explore EPCOT's World Showcase, featuring 11 country pavilions with authentic cuisine, cultural performances, and artisan crafts. Sample dishes from Mexico, Japan, France, and Morocco while enjoying live entertainment. Best experienced starting at midday when all pavilions are fully open. Book a Disney Resort hotel in the EPCOT area such as Disney's BoardWalk Inn or Disney's Beach Club Resort for walkable access, eliminating transport delays especially given the late Day 1 arrival.
experiences.location: EPCOT World Showcase, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure
experiences.description: Immerse your family in the Star Wars universe at Galaxy's Edge, featuring Rise of the Resistance, Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run, and the interactive Batuu land. Build a custom lightsaber at Savi's Workshop (advance reservation required). Arrive at park opening for the shortest wait times on headline attractions. Staying at Disney's Art of Animation Resort or Disney's Pop Century Resort provides direct Skyliner gondola access to Hollywood Studios, cutting transit time significantly.
experiences.location: Hollywood Studios, Galaxy's Edge, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney Springs Family Entertainment & Dining Evening
experiences.description: Spend a relaxed evening at Disney Springs, Disney's free-admission shopping, dining, and entertainment district. Enjoy dinner at The BOATHOUSE or T-REX Cafe, catch a show at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater, and browse unique Disney merchandise. This is an ideal activity for Day 1 since your flight arrives after 20:00 — Disney Springs stays open until 11:00 PM and requires no park ticket, making it a perfect low-key first-night option. Choose a hotel within Disney Springs Resort Area hotels for walking distance access.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage
experiences.description: Explore Disney's Animal Kingdom with a Kilimanjaro Safari ride to see live African wildlife, followed by the breathtaking Avatar Flight of Passage in Pandora – The World of Avatar. End the day with the Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular. Use Lightning Lane Multi Pass for Flight of Passage to avoid multi-hour waits. Staying at Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge places you steps from the park entrance and even offers savanna views of real animals from your room, making it the ideal base for this experience.
experiences.location: Animal Kingdom, Pandora – The World of Avatar, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 13:00. Take the Magical Express or budget-friendly Sunshine Flyer shuttle to Lake Buena Vista Boutique Stay. Check in, freshen up, and get oriented. Walk around the Lake Buena Vista area to get familiar with your surroundings. Visit the nearby Disney Springs (free admission) to explore the shops, waterfront views, and lively atmosphere. Pick up any essentials you may need for the week.
day_by_day.evening: Spend your first evening at Disney Springs — it's free to enter and a great way to ease into the Disney magic without spending on park tickets. Enjoy the entertainment, street performers, and ambiance. Browse the World of Disney store. Wind down and get to bed early to prepare for a full park day tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Meal on the plane or grab a quick snack at the airport
meals.lunch: Grab a quick and affordable bite at the airport or a fast-food spot near the hotel upon arrival — McDonald's or Subway near I-4/Lake Buena Vista area
meals.dinner: Disney Springs budget option: Chicken Guy! by Guy Fieri offers tasty chicken tenders at around $12–$15. Alternatively, head to the food trucks at Disney Springs for affordable eats around $10–$14.

day_by_day.notes: Day 1 is intentionally light. Use this time to rest, hydrate, and plan your park days. Download the My Disney Experience app if you haven't already — it's essential for ride wait times, mobile ordering, and Lightning Lane planning. Purchase park tickets in advance online to save money.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Magic Kingdom — the crown jewel of Walt Disney World. Arrive at park opening (typically 9:00 AM) to beat the crowds. Use the Early Entry benefit if available. Head straight to Tomorrowland to ride Space Mountain, then loop over to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and Peter Pan's Flight before lines get long. Use the free My Disney Experience app to monitor wait times throughout the day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Adventureland — ride Pirates of the Caribbean and the Jungle Cruise. Grab a quick-service lunch at Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn & Cafe in Frontierland. After lunch, head to Liberty Square to see the Haunted Mansion and then explore Frontierland for Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. Take a mid-afternoon break at the Main Street Bakery (Starbucks) for an iced coffee to recharge.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Fantasyland for rides like The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh and 'it's a small world.' Position yourself on Main Street USA or the Hub area for the evening parade and the spectacular Happily Ever After fireworks show (check the app for exact times). This is a highlight of the trip and completely included with park admission.

meals.breakfast: Eat breakfast at the hotel before heading out — grab cereal, fruit, or instant oatmeal from a grocery run to save money
meals.lunch: Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn & Cafe in Magic Kingdom — combo meals around $14–$16. Use mobile ordering to skip the line.
meals.dinner: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — budget-friendly quick service with clam chowder and sandwiches around $12–$15

day_by_day.notes: Magic Kingdom is the busiest park. Arrive at rope drop (park opening) to maximize your time. Wear comfortable shoes and bring a refillable water bottle — free water is available at quick-service locations. Check the My Disney Experience app for Lightning Lane availability if you want to skip lines on select rides for an extra fee.

day_by_day.morning: Head to EPCOT for a day of culture, technology, and fun. Arrive at opening and go directly to the new Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind roller coaster (join the virtual queue via the app as soon as the park opens). Then head to Test Track and Mission: SPACE in Future World. Take time to explore the stunning EPCOT Connections Eatery plaza area.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon exploring the World Showcase — walk through the pavilions of Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada. Each pavilion offers free cultural entertainment, films, and architecture to explore at no extra cost. Ride Frozen Ever After in the Norway Pavilion and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France Pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's nighttime spectacular — EPCOT Forever or Harmonious (check current schedule on the app). Watch the show from the World Showcase Lagoon for a magical end to the day. Grab a budget-friendly snack from one of the World Showcase food carts before heading back to the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the hotel before departure to save money
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in the Land Pavilion — one of the best quick-service values in all of Disney World with meals around $12–$15 including a drink
meals.dinner: World Showcase food stalls offer smaller, affordable plates — try a crepe from the France kiosk (~$8), a bratwurst from Germany (~$9), or school bread from Norway (~$5) for a fun, budget-friendly international tasting dinner

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is the most walkable park — wear comfortable shoes. The World Showcase doesn't open until 11:00 AM, so use the morning for Future World attractions. Pick up a free EPCOT Passport stamp booklet for kids at the front of the park — it's a fun free activity throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: Take a rest morning — sleep in and enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the hotel. Use this time to do laundry if needed, refill any snacks or groceries, and recharge. Head to a nearby Walmart or Publix (short drive or rideshare) to stock up on affordable snacks, water bottles, and breakfast items for the remaining days. This saves significant money over buying food in the parks.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Hollywood Studios in the afternoon. Head directly to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge — ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run and Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of the best rides in Disney history). Explore the incredible immersive land and browse Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities. Then head to Toy Story Land for Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers.
day_by_day.evening: Catch the incredible Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular nighttime fireworks show at Hollywood Studios (check app for times). Before the show, ride Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster in Sunset Boulevard if time allows. These thrill rides are best experienced in the evening with shorter waits.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast — cereal, fruit, yogurt, or toast from your grocery haul
meals.lunch: Late lunch / early afternoon snack from your packed snacks before entering the park
meals.dinner: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — one of the most affordable quick-service spots in Hollywood Studios, with meals around $11–$14. Try the Totchos (tater tot nachos)!

day_by_day.notes: A mid-trip rest morning is essential for budget travelers — it saves money and prevents burnout. Hollywood Studios is best experienced in the afternoon/evening when you're refreshed. Rise of the Resistance virtual queue or Individual Lightning Lane may be required — check the app at 7:00 AM on the day of your visit.

day_by_day.morning: Spend the day at Disney's Animal Kingdom. Arrive at rope drop and head immediately to Pandora – The World of Avatar. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage first thing (it has the longest waits in the park — often 90+ minutes by mid-morning). Then ride Na'vi River Journey. Take time to soak in the breathtaking bioluminescent landscape of Pandora.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa — take the Kilimanjaro Safaris for an incredible live animal experience included with park admission. Visit the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for free animal viewing. Head to Asia for Expedition Everest and Kali River Rapids (you will get wet!). Explore DinoLand U.S.A. and ride DINOSAUR for a thrilling adventure.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Rivers of Light nighttime show or Tree of Life Awakenings — the Tree of Life comes alive with projected animal imagery after dark and it's completely free with park admission. Grab a snack and find a spot near the Tree of Life for a magical evening experience before heading back to the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the hotel before heading out
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue near Discovery Island — one of the best quick-service meals in all of Disney World with BBQ platters around $14–$17. Eat outside by the waterfront for a beautiful setting.
meals.dinner: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — healthy and delicious bowls with rice, protein, and sauces for around $14–$16. One of the best quick-service values at Animal Kingdom.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks — typically by 8:00–9:00 PM. Check the app for exact hours. Bring a poncho for Kali River Rapids or wear clothes you don't mind getting wet. The park is beautifully landscaped — take time to explore the trails and gardens between rides.

day_by_day.morning: Take a free morning to visit Disney Springs again — this time with more time to explore. Browse the shops, visit the LEGO store (free to browse), and check out the Marketplace Co-Op. Visit the free AMC Disney Springs 24 movie theater lobby area or browse the art galleries. This is a great low-cost morning activity.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to your favorite park for a half-day visit — we recommend going back to Magic Kingdom or EPCOT to catch any rides or experiences you missed. Alternatively, if budget allows, consider visiting Disney's Typhoon Lagoon or Blizzard Beach water park for a fun afternoon splash (separate ticket required — look for discounted tickets online or through your hotel).
day_by_day.evening: Spend your second-to-last evening at Disney Springs for the free outdoor entertainment. Enjoy the live music at the Marketplace Stage or West Side stage (free performances nightly). Treat yourself to a budget-friendly splurge dessert — the Ghirardelli ice cream sundae or a Sprinkles cupcake as a trip celebration.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast from your grocery supplies
meals.lunch: Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza at Disney Springs — build your own pizza for around $10–$12, a great value
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs has a more upscale feel but the bar menu and appetizers are affordable. Alternatively, Earl of Sandwich at Disney Springs offers hot sandwiches for around $8–$10 — one of the best budget dining deals on Disney property.

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is completely free to enter and park. Use the free Disney Springs parking garages (Orange and Lime garages). This day offers flexibility — use it to revisit favorites, rest, or explore at your own pace. Check the Disney Springs event calendar for any free live entertainment or special events.

day_by_day.morning: Check out of the hotel and store your luggage with the front desk if your flight is in the afternoon. Take one final stroll around Lake Buena Vista or Disney Springs for last-minute souvenir shopping. Visit the World of Disney store at Disney Springs for the widest selection at standard Disney pricing — avoid impulse buys and stick to your budget for meaningful keepsakes.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your flight time, head to the airport with plenty of time to spare. Use Sunshine Flyer, Mears Connect, or a rideshare (Uber/Lyft) from Lake Buena Vista to Orlando International Airport. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for check-in, security, and boarding at MCO.
day_by_day.evening: Travel home with incredible memories from your Disney World adventure!

meals.breakfast: Use up remaining hotel groceries for a final free breakfast — pack any remaining snacks for the journey home
meals.lunch: Grab a final affordable meal at Disney Springs before heading to the airport — Earl of Sandwich is a perfect last meal at around $8–$10
meals.dinner: Airport dining or in-flight meal

day_by_day.notes: Budget tip: Save your Disney resort receipts — some credit cards offer travel purchase protections. For souvenirs, the best value is at the Disney Springs World of Disney store or outlet stores near Orlando. Avoid buying souvenirs inside the parks where prices are the same but crowds make shopping stressful. Total estimated daily park food budget: $40–$55 per adult per day eating quick-service meals and bringing snacks from outside.

trip_options.title: Classic Disney World, Orlando, Florida Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival & Check-In: Flight LH lands at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled. Travel from Orlando International Airport to Lake Buena Vista Boutique Stay (~30 min by shuttle or rideshare). Check in, freshen up, and get oriented with the resort amenities.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs Family Entertainment & Dining: Head to Disney Springs (free admission, ~5–10 min drive from hotel) for a relaxed first afternoon. Explore the marketplace, browse Disney merchandise, catch live street performances, and let the kids soak in the Disney atmosphere without the pressure of a full park day.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Evening Entertainment: Stay into the evening for dinner and entertainment. Enjoy the waterfront atmosphere, check out the LEGO Store, AMC Disney Springs 24 movie complex, or live music at various venues across the West Side and Town Center.

meals.breakfast: Grab something at the airport or on the plane before landing.
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs — a mid-range quick-service spot with gourmet burgers and milkshakes, great for the whole family (~$15–20 per person).
meals.dinner: The Boathouse at Disney Springs — waterfront dining with seafood, steaks, and American classics. Moderate pricing (~$30–45 per person). Make a reservation in advance or check walk-in availability upon arrival.

day_by_day.notes: Purchase or link your Disney park tickets and set up the My Disney Experience app today. Book Lightning Lane Multi Pass for upcoming park days. Pack a refillable water bottle — Orlando in June is hot and humid. Dress in light, breathable clothing.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom — Early Entry & Iconic Rides: Arrive at Magic Kingdom for rope drop (park opens ~9:00 AM, Early Theme Park Entry at 8:30 AM for hotel guests). Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain, then Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train using Lightning Lane. Ride Peter Pan's Flight and visit Cinderella Castle for photos.
day_by_day.afternoon: Magic Kingdom — Parades, Shows & More Attractions: After lunch, catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (check schedule). Ride Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, Haunted Mansion, and Pirates of the Caribbean. Use Lightning Lane strategically for headliner attractions. Take a mid-afternoon break at the hotel if needed — return refreshed for the evening.
day_by_day.evening: Magic Kingdom — Happily Ever After Fireworks: Return to Magic Kingdom for the nighttime spectacular 'Disney Enchantment' or 'Happily Ever After' fireworks show over Cinderella Castle. Stake out a spot on Main Street U.S.A. at least 30–45 minutes early. End the night with a Main Street Electrical Parade if scheduled.

meals.breakfast: The Wave… of American Flavors at Disney's Contemporary Resort (nearby, ~$20–25 per person) or a quick breakfast at the hotel before heading out.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square, Magic Kingdom — counter-service with sandwiches, clam chowder, and fish & chips (~$12–18 per person). Quieter than many other quick-service spots.
meals.dinner: Be Our Guest Restaurant in Fantasyland, Magic Kingdom — a beloved mid-range table-service restaurant themed to Beauty and the Beast. Book well in advance (~$25–40 per person). Alternatively, grab dinner at Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn & Café for a budget-friendly option.

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable walking shoes — expect 10–15 miles of walking. Apply sunscreen regularly. Download the My Disney Experience app for real-time wait times. Lightning Lane Multi Pass is highly recommended for Magic Kingdom. Stay hydrated throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT — Future World & World Discovery: Arrive at EPCOT for Early Entry (~8:30 AM). Head to Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (Lightning Lane Individual required — book at 7:00 AM) or Test Track. Explore World Discovery and World Nature areas, including Spaceship Earth and Living with the Land boat ride.
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour: The World Showcase opens at 11:00 AM. Spend the afternoon grazing through international pavilions — try authentic dishes and snacks from Mexico, Japan, France, Italy, Morocco, and more. Catch cultural performances and browse artisan shops. This is one of EPCOT's most unique and family-friendly experiences.
day_by_day.evening: EPCOT Harmonious Nighttime Spectacular: Stay for EPCOT's nighttime show 'Harmonious' (or its successor) — one of the largest nighttime spectaculars ever created, featuring fireworks, water screens, and music from Disney films. Enjoy a final dessert or drink from a World Showcase pavilion while watching.

meals.breakfast: Quick continental breakfast at the hotel or pick up pastries at the France Pavilion Boulangerie Pâtisserie once World Showcase opens.
meals.lunch: World Showcase grazing — try a Ramen bowl at the Japan Pavilion Katsura Grill (~$14–18), a School Bread from Norway's Kringla Bakeri (~$6), and a snack from Mexico's La Cantina de San Angel (~$10–15). Budget ~$30–40 total for a fun, diverse lunch.
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo at the Japan Pavilion — a lively hibachi-style table-service restaurant with theatrical cooking. Great for families (~$30–45 per person). Reserve in advance on My Disney Experience.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is a large park — comfortable shoes are essential. The World Showcase is best experienced slowly, so don't rush. International Festival events (Flower & Garden, Food & Wine, etc.) may be running in June — check the EPCOT festival calendar for bonus offerings and outdoor kitchens.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios — Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure: Arrive early for rope drop at Hollywood Studios. Make your way directly to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge. Ride Rise of the Resistance (one of the most immersive theme park experiences ever built) using Lightning Lane Individual — book at 7:00 AM. Then ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Explore Black Spire Outpost, build a lightsaber at Savi's Workshop (premium, ~$249.99 — optional), or create a droid at the Droid Depot (~$119.99 — optional).
day_by_day.afternoon: Hollywood Studios — Toy Story Land & Tower of Terror: After Galaxy's Edge, head to Toy Story Land for Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Then visit the Twilight Zone Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith for thrill seekers. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show (check schedule).
day_by_day.evening: Hollywood Studios — Fantasmic! & Nighttime Shows: End the day with Fantasmic!, Hollywood Studios' iconic nighttime lagoon show featuring Mickey Mouse, Disney villains, and massive water and fire effects. Book a Fantasmic! dining package for guaranteed seating. Alternatively, watch the Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular fireworks show.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at the hotel or pick up a Blue Milk or Green Milk and a Ronto Wrap from Ronto Roasters in Galaxy's Edge (~$12–15) for an immersive Star Wars breakfast experience.
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — a popular quick-service spot with grilled cheese sandwiches, totchos, and specialty lemonades (~$12–18 per person). Arrive early or late to avoid peak lines.
meals.dinner: Hollywood & Vine — a classic Hollywood Studios buffet restaurant with character dining (characters may vary by season). Great for families (~$45–55 per adult, ~$30 per child). Book in advance. Alternatively, Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant for a unique drive-in movie atmosphere (~$20–35 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is extremely popular in summer — arrive at rope drop. Lightning Lane Individual for Rise of the Resistance sells out within minutes of 7:00 AM booking — set an alarm. Savi's Workshop and Droid Depot require reservations and are premium add-ons; decide in advance if your budget allows.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom — Kilimanjaro Safari & Wildlife Exploration: Arrive at Animal Kingdom for Early Entry (~8:30 AM). Head immediately to Kilimanjaro Safaris in the Africa section — animals are most active in the cooler morning hours. See lions, elephants, giraffes, rhinos, and more in a naturalistic open savanna setting. Then explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for up-close wildlife encounters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Animal Kingdom — Pandora: World of Avatar: After lunch, head to Pandora — The World of Avatar. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage (use Lightning Lane Individual, booked at 7:00 AM — this is the park's most sought-after attraction). Then ride Na'vi River Journey for a beautiful, family-friendly boat experience. Explore the bioluminescent landscape of Pandora. Also catch Finding Nemo: The Big Blue… and Beyond! show at the Theater in the Wild.
day_by_day.evening: Animal Kingdom — Rivers of Light & Relaxed Dinner: Enjoy the Tree of Life Awakenings (the Tree of Light comes alive with animal imagery projected onto it after dark — check times). If available, catch the nighttime spectacular. Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks, so plan to exit by 8:00–9:00 PM and enjoy a relaxed dinner nearby.

meals.breakfast: Grab a light breakfast at the hotel or pick up a Pongu Pongu drink and a snack at Pandora when it opens.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora, Animal Kingdom — one of the best quick-service restaurants in all of Walt Disney World. Customizable grain bowls with proteins and sauces, inspired by Pandoran cuisine (~$15–20 per person). Healthy and delicious.
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant near Asia section in Animal Kingdom — a sit-down restaurant with pan-Asian cuisine including Mandarin chicken, pot stickers, and lo mein (~$20–35 per person). Book in advance. Alternatively, dine at a nearby restaurant in the Lake Buena Vista area after exiting the park.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is a walking-intensive park with lots of outdoor trails — wear sunscreen and bring insect repellent. The park is most enjoyable in the morning when wildlife is active and temperatures are cooler. Flight of Passage Lightning Lane Individual is essential — book at exactly 7:00 AM.

day_by_day.morning: Resort Relaxation & Pool Morning: Take a well-deserved rest morning. Sleep in, enjoy a leisurely hotel breakfast, and spend the morning at the hotel pool or exploring the Lake Buena Vista area. This is a great opportunity to recharge after four intense park days. Browse the nearby Disney Springs area for any last-minute shopping.
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT or Magic Kingdom — Revisit Favorites: Use this flexible afternoon to revisit your favorite park for any missed attractions or experiences. Alternatively, explore Disney's BoardWalk area (free to walk) for a relaxed waterfront stroll, street performers, and casual dining. If energy is high, return to Magic Kingdom for any missed rides or to experience it with shorter Saturday afternoon crowds using Lightning Lane.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Farewell Entertainment Evening: Return to Disney Springs for a final festive evening. Catch a movie at AMC Disney Springs 24, enjoy live music at Raglan Road Irish Pub, or take a hot air balloon ride on Aerophile — The World Leader in Balloon Flight (~$25 per adult, ~$20 per child) for stunning aerial views of the Walt Disney World resort at sunset.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely hotel breakfast or nearby café — try First Watch or Keke's Breakfast Café in the Lake Buena Vista area (~$12–18 per person) for a classic American breakfast.
meals.lunch: Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza or Chicken Guy! at Disney Springs for a quick, affordable, and delicious mid-day meal (~$12–16 per person).
meals.dinner: Raglan Road Irish Pub & Restaurant at Disney Springs — a lively, family-friendly Irish pub with live music, traditional Irish food with a modern twist, and a fun atmosphere (~$20–35 per person). No reservation required for bar seating; reservations recommended for table dining.

day_by_day.notes: Saturday is typically the busiest day at Disney World — use this as a lighter park day or off-park day to avoid peak crowds. This is also a great day for souvenir shopping and packing. Check if any special events or seasonal entertainment is happening at Disney Springs or the resort hotels.

day_by_day.morning: Final Morning — Departure Preparation & Last Memories: Enjoy a final hotel breakfast and complete packing. Depending on your flight time, take one last stroll through Disney Springs for any forgotten souvenirs or a final Disney treat. Check out of the hotel and arrange transportation to Orlando International Airport.
day_by_day.afternoon: Airport Departure: Head to Orlando International Airport with plenty of time before your flight. Allow at least 2–2.5 hours before departure for check-in, security, and boarding. Enjoy a final Florida meal at one of the airport's dining options before your flight home.
day_by_day.evening: Travel Home: Board your flight and relive the magical memories of your Disney World adventure!

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or a quick grab-and-go from a nearby café — fuel up before the journey home.
meals.lunch: Light lunch at Disney Springs if time allows, or dine at the airport. Orlando International Airport has a solid selection of restaurants including Outback Steakhouse, The Bubbalou's Bodacious Bar-B-Que, and various grab-and-go options (~$15–25 per person).
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or upon arrival at your home destination.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your flight details and check-in online the night before. Arrange airport transportation in advance (rideshare, shuttle, or rental car return). Keep a carry-on bag with any Disney merchandise that is fragile or valuable. Take a moment before leaving to reflect on the trip — Disney World is a once-in-a-lifetime experience for many families. Safe travels!

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Disney World, Orlando, Florida Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day
experiences.description: Spend a full day at the iconic Magic Kingdom, home to Cinderella Castle, Space Mountain, and the Festival of Fantasy parade. Arrive at rope drop (park opening) to maximize ride time and avoid peak crowds. With a late flight arrival on Day 1, plan this for Day 2 onward. Stay on-site at a Disney Resort hotel such as Disney's Contemporary Resort or Disney's Polynesian Village Resort to use Early Theme Park Entry and minimize travel time to the park gates.
experiences.location: Magic Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour
experiences.description: Explore EPCOT's World Showcase, featuring 11 country pavilions with authentic cuisine, cultural performances, and artisan crafts. Sample dishes from Mexico, Japan, France, and Morocco while enjoying live entertainment. Best experienced starting at midday when all pavilions are fully open. Book a Disney Resort hotel in the EPCOT area such as Disney's BoardWalk Inn or Disney's Beach Club Resort for walkable access, eliminating transport delays especially given the late Day 1 arrival.
experiences.location: EPCOT World Showcase, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure
experiences.description: Immerse your family in the Star Wars universe at Galaxy's Edge, featuring Rise of the Resistance, Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run, and the interactive Batuu land. Build a custom lightsaber at Savi's Workshop (advance reservation required). Arrive at park opening for the shortest wait times on headline attractions. Staying at Disney's Art of Animation Resort or Disney's Pop Century Resort provides direct Skyliner gondola access to Hollywood Studios, cutting transit time significantly.
experiences.location: Hollywood Studios, Galaxy's Edge, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney Springs Family Entertainment & Dining Evening
experiences.description: Spend a relaxed evening at Disney Springs, Disney's free-admission shopping, dining, and entertainment district. Enjoy dinner at The BOATHOUSE or T-REX Cafe, catch a show at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater, and browse unique Disney merchandise. This is an ideal activity for Day 1 since your flight arrives after 20:00 — Disney Springs stays open until 11:00 PM and requires no park ticket, making it a perfect low-key first-night option. Choose a hotel within Disney Springs Resort Area hotels for walking distance access.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage
experiences.description: Explore Disney's Animal Kingdom with a Kilimanjaro Safari ride to see live African wildlife, followed by the breathtaking Avatar Flight of Passage in Pandora – The World of Avatar. End the day with the Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular. Use Lightning Lane Multi Pass for Flight of Passage to avoid multi-hour waits. Staying at Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge places you steps from the park entrance and even offers savanna views of real animals from your room, making it the ideal base for this experience.
experiences.location: Animal Kingdom, Pandora – The World of Avatar, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

day_by_day.morning: Flight LH arrives at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled. Relax on board and prepare for arrival.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 13:00. Transfer via private luxury car service to Lake Buena Vista Boutique Stay. Check in, freshen up, and settle into your premium accommodations. Take a leisurely stroll around the resort grounds to acclimate to the Florida warmth and explore hotel amenities including pool and concierge services.
day_by_day.evening: Head to Disney Springs for a relaxed first-night introduction to the Disney World experience. Enjoy world-class shopping at boutiques like Anthropologie and Sugarboo & Co., followed by live entertainment from street performers and live music stages. Wind down the evening with a scenic walk along the waterfront.

meals.breakfast: Enjoy breakfast on the plane or grab a light snack at the airport upon arrival.
meals.lunch: Grab a gourmet bite at The Edison at Disney Springs — an industrial gothic-themed restaurant offering artisan cocktails and elevated American comfort food upon arrival.
meals.dinner: Dine at Morimoto Asia at Disney Springs — celebrity chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship restaurant offering exquisite Pan-Asian cuisine including whole roasted Peking duck, sushi, and wagyu beef in a stunning two-story setting.

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange private airport transfer through your hotel concierge for a seamless luxury arrival. Request early check-in if possible. Pick up your Disney MagicBand+ wristbands and pre-purchased Park Hopper Plus tickets from the hotel concierge. Disney Springs is free admission — perfect for a low-key first evening after travel.

day_by_day.morning: Full Day at Magic Kingdom — arrive at park rope drop (typically 8:00 AM or earlier with Early Theme Park Entry benefit available to Disney resort guests). Begin with Cinderella Castle photo opportunities before crowds arrive. Immediately head to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin using Lightning Lane Premier Pass for zero wait times. Continue to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and Peter Pan's Flight.
day_by_day.afternoon: After lunch, experience Liberty Square's Haunted Mansion and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad in Frontierland. Use Lightning Lane selections strategically for top-tier attractions. Enjoy the afternoon parade — Festival of Fantasy — along Main Street U.S.A. for a spectacular mid-day spectacle. Cool off with Splash Mountain's successor Tiana's Bayou Adventure and take a relaxing break at the resort-style Fantasyland area.
day_by_day.evening: Stake out a premium viewing spot on Main Street U.S.A. or reserve a fireworks dessert party package for the iconic 'Disney Enchantment' nighttime spectacular with exclusive reserved viewing, unlimited desserts, and sparkling beverages. Cap the night with a stroll through the illuminated castle before park close.

meals.breakfast: Cinderella's Royal Table inside Cinderella Castle — a bucket-list character dining experience with princesses, panoramic castle views, and a prix-fixe breakfast menu. Book 60 days in advance.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House or Be Our Guest Restaurant in Fantasyland — Be Our Guest offers an elegant French-inspired menu in the Beast's enchanted castle ballroom setting.
meals.dinner: The Plaza Restaurant on Main Street U.S.A. for a refined, nostalgic dining experience, or exit to Disney's Grand Floridian Resort's Narcoossee's for waterfront fine dining with views of the Magic Kingdom fireworks.

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Premier Pass for Magic Kingdom to bypass queues on all major attractions. Wear comfortable premium sneakers — expect 15,000+ steps. Bring portable fans and cooling towels for June Florida heat. Magic Kingdom is the most emotionally resonant park — ideal for Day 2 when energy is highest.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios — Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure. Arrive at Early Entry (8:00 AM) and head directly to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge. Be among the first to board Rise of the Resistance, widely considered the most technologically advanced theme park attraction in the world. Follow immediately with Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run, where your family pilots the iconic ship. Visit Savi's Workshop to hand-build a custom lightsaber (reservation required — a truly premium keepsake experience).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the rest of Hollywood Studios: ride Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania in Toy Story Land, then experience the thrilling Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith in Sunset Boulevard. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular live show for a high-energy afternoon performance. Visit Oga's Cantina in Galaxy's Edge for exotic themed cocktails and mocktails in an immersive Star Wars bar atmosphere.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for 'Fantasmic!' — Hollywood Studios' spectacular nighttime show featuring Mickey Mouse battling villains with water screens, fireworks, and live performers. Reserve a Fantasmic! Dining Package for guaranteed premium seating. After the show, browse Galaxy's Edge merchandise at Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities for rare collectibles.

meals.breakfast: Enjoy a lavish breakfast at your Lake Buena Vista hotel before heading to the park — request a premium in-room breakfast service or visit the hotel's signature restaurant.
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge — an immersive Star Wars-themed quick-service restaurant with creative dishes like Smoked Kaadu Ribs and Felucian Kefta.
meals.dinner: Hollywood Brown Derby — Hollywood Studios' signature fine dining restaurant modeled after the legendary 1930s Hollywood icon, offering the original Cobb Salad, prime beef, and an extensive wine list.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop lightsaber building costs approximately $250 per lightsaber and requires advance reservations — book at 60-day mark. Oga's Cantina also requires reservations. Lightning Lane Premier Pass is highly recommended for Hollywood Studios. Consider booking the Star Wars: Galactic Starcruiser experience (if still operating) as an optional overnight immersive hotel adventure.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — arrive at EPCOT for Early Entry at 8:00 AM and begin with Future World attractions: Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane required), Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France Pavilion, and Test Track presented by Chevrolet. Explore Spaceship Earth, EPCOT's iconic geodesic sphere attraction, for a reflective journey through human communication history.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on a self-guided World Showcase culinary tour beginning at 11:00 AM when the pavilions open. Journey through all 11 country pavilions — Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada. Sample authentic cuisine and beverages at each pavilion. Hire a private EPCOT VIP Tour Guide through Disney's official VIP Tour Services for an expert-led cultural and culinary deep-dive with reserved seating and skip-the-line access.
day_by_day.evening: Experience EPCOT's 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Harmonious' nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon — one of the largest nighttime shows ever created for a Disney park. Reserve a premium IllumiNations or Harmonious Dessert Party for lagoon-side reserved seating with curated desserts and drinks. End the evening with a nightcap at La Cava del Tequila in the Mexico Pavilion.

meals.breakfast: Katsura Grill or Teppan Edo in the Japan Pavilion for an early lunch, or start with a pastry and café au lait at Les Halles Boulangerie-Patisserie in the France Pavilion.
meals.lunch: Teppan Edo in the Japan Pavilion — an authentic teppanyaki dining experience with skilled chefs preparing premium meats and seafood tableside in an elegant setting.
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul in the France Pavilion — EPCOT's most prestigious fine dining restaurant, a tribute to legendary chef Paul Bocuse, offering classic French haute cuisine with impeccable service and an award-winning wine cellar.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase is a UNESCO-recognized cultural experience within a theme park. Consider pre-purchasing the EPCOT Food & Wine Festival add-on passport if visiting during a festival period. La Cava del Tequila is a hidden gem — reservations strongly recommended. The VIP Tour experience costs $450–$900/hour and is worth every penny for a family seeking a seamless, curated experience.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom — Safari & Avatar Experience. Arrive at Early Entry (8:00 AM) and immediately head to Pandora – The World of Avatar. Secure Lightning Lane for Avatar: Flight of Passage — the park's crown jewel attraction and arguably the most breathtaking ride in Walt Disney World, featuring a breathtaking banshee flight over the bioluminescent world of Pandora. Follow with Na'vi River Journey for a serene boat ride through glowing Pandoran rainforest.
day_by_day.afternoon: Board the Kilimanjaro Safari in Africa for a 30-minute open-air safari vehicle ride through 110 acres of authentic African savanna habitats, encountering live giraffes, elephants, lions, rhinos, and hippos up close. Take the Wildlife Express Train to Rafiki's Planet Watch for a behind-the-scenes look at animal care. Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for immersive wildlife encounters. Experience DINOSAUR and Expedition Everest – Legend of the Forbidden Mountain for thrilling afternoon rides.
day_by_day.evening: Attend 'Rivers of Light: We Are One' — Animal Kingdom's nighttime spectacular featuring floating lanterns, water screens, and animal imagery projected across the Discovery River. Explore the atmospheric Harambe Market area after dark for a vibrant African village ambiance with live entertainment and fire dancers.

meals.breakfast: Tusker House Restaurant — a beloved character dining buffet featuring Donald Duck and friends in safari attire, with an extensive spread of African-inspired and American breakfast favorites.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — beautifully designed Avatar-themed restaurant offering healthy, flavorful bowls with premium proteins and unique Pandoran-inspired beverages in a stunning bioluminescent setting.
meals.dinner: Tiffins Restaurant — Animal Kingdom's signature fine dining establishment celebrating global exploration with sophisticated cuisine inspired by the travels of Disney's Imagineers. Features an extraordinary art collection and an extensive wine and spirits program.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is most magical in the early morning when animals are most active — the Kilimanjaro Safari at rope drop offers the best wildlife sightings. Bring binoculars for the safari. Tiffins is one of the most underrated fine dining experiences in all of Walt Disney World — reservations are essential. The park closes earlier than others, so plan your day efficiently.

day_by_day.morning: Luxury Resort Day & Spa Morning. Enjoy a leisurely morning at your Lake Buena Vista Boutique Stay. Indulge in a premium couples' or family spa treatment — request the hotel concierge to arrange massages, facials, or hydrotherapy sessions. Enjoy a late, unhurried breakfast by the pool. Take time to relax, recharge, and reflect on the week's magical experiences. Optional: visit Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa for their world-class spa facilities if your hotel doesn't offer full spa services.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Magic Kingdom or EPCOT for a relaxed 'Park Hopper' afternoon — revisit favorite attractions with no agenda pressure. Alternatively, book a private Disney VIP Tour for a curated behind-the-scenes experience of your chosen park with a dedicated guide, private transportation, and guaranteed front-of-line access to all attractions. Use the afternoon to collect final souvenirs, revisit beloved experiences, and soak in the Disney magic one last time.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Family Entertainment & Dining Evening — spend a festive final full evening at Disney Springs. Enjoy live music at the House of Blues or outdoor stages, browse luxury boutiques and Disney flagship stores, visit the LEGO Store and World of Disney for premium gifts and keepsakes. Watch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 Theatre if desired.

meals.breakfast: Indulge in an elaborate in-room breakfast or champagne brunch at your hotel's finest dining venue — request a special setup from the concierge for a memorable morning.
meals.lunch: Paddlefish at Disney Springs — a stunning three-deck converted steamboat offering premium seafood including whole Maine lobster, king crab legs, and fresh oysters with panoramic waterfront views.
meals.dinner: STK Orlando at Disney Springs — an upscale modern steakhouse offering USDA prime dry-aged steaks, premium seafood towers, craft cocktails, and a vibrant rooftop atmosphere perfect for a celebratory final dinner.

day_by_day.notes: This day is intentionally designed as a recovery and flexibility day — six days of theme park touring is physically demanding, especially in Florida June heat. Use this day to let the family choose their own adventure. Consider booking a private fireworks cruise on Seven Seas Lagoon to watch Magic Kingdom's 'Disney Enchantment' from the water — an extraordinary luxury experience available through Disney's marina.

day_by_day.morning: Final Morning — Farewell to Orlando. Enjoy a relaxed, luxurious final breakfast at the hotel. Pack and prepare for checkout. Arrange private luxury car transfer to Orlando International Airport through the hotel concierge. Take one last walk around the resort property to capture memories. If flight is late afternoon or evening, store luggage with the concierge and enjoy the hotel pool or visit a nearby Disney Springs boutique for any last-minute luxury purchases.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on flight departure time, enjoy a farewell lunch in Lake Buena Vista or at the airport's premium lounges. If time permits, revisit Disney Springs for a final browse or enjoy the hotel's pool and amenities until transfer time. Depart for Orlando International Airport with private car service — allow at least 2.5 hours before international departure.
day_by_day.evening: Board your return flight home, carrying magical memories, luxury keepsakes, and the unmistakable joy of a world-class Disney World experience.

meals.breakfast: Final luxury breakfast at your hotel — request a special farewell setup with champagne, seasonal fruits, pastries, and a full hot breakfast as a celebratory send-off.
meals.lunch: The Boathouse at Disney Springs for a final lakeside meal featuring prime steaks, fresh seafood, and the iconic Captain's Platters — perfect for a memorable farewell lunch with waterfront views and vintage amphicar boat tours.
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Orlando International — visit the premium dining options in the main terminal, or enjoy a meal in the Delta One or other airline premium lounge if applicable to your ticket class.

day_by_day.notes: Request late checkout from your Lake Buena Vista hotel to maximize comfort on departure day — most luxury properties accommodate this with advance notice. Ensure all MagicBand+ wristbands, PhotoPass downloads (purchase Memory Maker for unlimited digital photos from the entire trip), and merchandise are packed securely. Disney's Memory Maker photo package captures all on-ride photos and professional photographer shots throughout the parks — download all images before departure.
